cases.title: The notes can't be read: one sentence about it, then a first lesson, nothing said before the snapshot

rubric.reason: The mentor's reply opens with a single plain statement, "I couldn't read my notes from your earlier lessons...", and nothing before the snapshot call. It names no file, field or error code, claims no earlier lessons, and goes straight into a first lesson on Title.

Every name and time matches the snapshot: Mentor Practice, Title's Position 0.5–1.5, 1.5–3 and 3–4.37 s (4.367 rounded), Scale 0.5–1.5 s, Old Take, CTRL, Icon, Logo's Rotation, and Subtitle's Opacity, Bar's X Position and Glow's Blurriness.
The mentor never says what the learner has or hasn't learned. "Still need easing. That's the easing lesson" describes the comp's pairs, not the learner's history.

Nothing is said before the snapshot call. The reply then opens with a single plain mention ('I couldn't read my notes from your earlier lessons. They're kept as they were, and I'll start new notes from this lesson.'), names no file, field or error code, and goes straight into a first lesson on Title.

Every layer, property and time the mentor names matches the snapshot output: Title's Position 0.5–1.5 s, 1.5–3 s and 3–4.367 s ('about 4.37 s'), Title's Scale 0.5–1.5 s, plus Old Take, CTRL, Icon, Logo's Rotation, Subtitle's Opacity, Bar's X Position and Glow's Blurriness.
The mentor makes no statement about what the learner has or hasn't learned. 'Still need easing; that's the easing lesson' describes the comp's pairs, not the learner's history.

The mentor said nothing before the snapshot call, then opened with one plain statement, "I couldn't read my notes from your earlier lessons...", without naming a file, field or error code, and went straight into a first lesson on Title in Mentor Practice.

Every name and time matches the snapshot: Title's Position at 0.5–1.5, 1.5–3 and 3–4.37 s, Scale at 0.5–1.5 s, Old Take (hidden), CTRL (null), Icon (precomp), Logo's Rotation (expression), and Subtitle's Opacity, Bar's X Position and Glow's Blurriness (ease first).

The mentor made no claim about the learner's past; "Subtitle's Opacity, Bar's X Position and Glow's Blurriness still need easing" describes the comp's keys, and it never says the learner hasn't learned easing, even though the second snapshot reported learned: false.
